name: omnibase/restaurant
description: A restaurant on omnibase: the dining room and its layouts (a floor-plan editor, a QR poster per table), meal services and table reservations (availability under a lock, a public form, a management link, ICS), the menu (dishes as omnibase/marketplace products, sections, set menus, EU allergens), ordering at the table by QR code (sessions, rounds, tickets), the pass for the staff, and the delivery and booking platforms through glitchr/omnifood.

suggest.glitchr/omnifood: The delivery and booking platforms (omnifood/ubereats, omnifood/deliveroo, omnifood/justeat, omnifood/thefork): their orders become tickets on the pass, their reservations join the book, the menu and the out-of-stock dishes are pushed to them.
